title: Application of pseudotyped virus particles to monitor Ebola virus and SARS-CoV-2 viral entry in human cell lines
protocol: Wash HEK293T cells gently with 1× DPBS.
Resuspend the washed cells in fresh complete DMEM medium.
Detach the cells by repeated up and down pipetting.
Count the cells using a hemocytometer.
Adjust the cell concentration to 5 × 10^5 cells/well in a 6-well plate.
Replace the medium with 1 mL of fresh complete DMEM medium per well.
Prepare the transfection complex solution in a 1.5 mL tube.
Mix OPTI-MEM with Genejuice.
Vortex the mixture briefly.
Spin the mixture at 200 × g for 30 seconds.
Incubate the mixture for 5 minutes at room temperature (20°C–23°C).
Add pCMV-MLV-gag-pol, pCMV-Luc, and pcDNA3.1-EBOV-GP or pcDNA3.1-SARS-CoV-2-S to the transfection reagent mix.
Briefly vortex the sample.
Spin the sample at 200 × g for 30 seconds.
For MLV pseudovirus production without viral surface glycoprotein, add pCMV-MLV-gag-pol, pCMV-Luc, and pcDNA3.1 empty vector to the transfection complex solution.
Briefly vortex the sample.
Spin the sample at 200 × g for 30 seconds.
Incubate the transfection complex solution for 15 minutes.
Gently pipette the transfection complex drop-wise onto the cells.
Mix the plates by gentle swirling to ensure equal distribution.
Incubate the transfected cells in a cell culture incubator at 37°C with 5% CO2.
After 6 hours, replace the medium with fresh complete medium by gentle pipetting.
Remove the old medium with extra caution to avoid cell loss.
Collect pseudovirus supernatants from cells 24 hours after medium change into 50 mL centrifuge tubes.
Store collected supernatants at -80°C.
Add 1 mL of fresh complete DMEM on the cells.
Collect pseudoviral supernatants from cells 48 hours after medium change into 50 mL centrifuge tubes.
Store these collected supernatants separately at -80°C.
Thaw pseudoviral supernatants.
Pool the two batches of thawed pseudoviral supernatants.
Filter the pooled supernatants through a 0.45 μm PVDF filter unit to remove cell debris.
Store filtered pseudoviral supernatants at -80°C.
Centrifuge the pseudoviral supernatants (600–900 × g for 8 minutes at 4°C) prior to filtration if needed.
Prepare aliquots of the pseudoviral supernatants.
Wash and lyse remaining cells in plate using 55 μL luciferase lysis buffer.
Transfer 50 μL cell lysate to a 96-well white microtiter plate.
Incubate cell lysate for 15 min at room temperature (RT).
Add 90 μL luciferin substrate to the lysates.
Measure luciferase activity using a luminometer with 500 ms integration.
Reconstitute human EAhy.926 cells in cell culture for at least two passages.
Wash EA.hy926 cells with 1× DPBS.
Detach cells using Trypsin/EDTA (0.05%) typically incubating less than 5 minutes at 37°C.
Resuspend detached cells in 10 mL prewarmed fresh complete RPMI1640 medium.
Count the resuspended cells.
Seed 2 × 10^5 cells in 1 mL/well of a 12-well plate to reach 70–80% confluency on the next day.
Thaw MLV-control/MLV-EBOV-GP viral supernatants and prewarm them at 37°C for no longer than 15 minutes before use.
Completely remove medium from cells.
Replace removed medium with 1 mL of pseudoviral supernatant.
Incubate cells at 37°C in a 5% CO2 environment.
Optional: Make 1:2 serial dilutions of the supernatants prior to first measurement.
Measure luciferase activity as described at step 12.
Plot a Titer/Relative Luminescence Unit (RLU) curve to determine the most efficient volume for transduction.
Thaw Luciferase Lysis Buffer and prepare sufficient amount of 1× solution by adding ddH2O to the concentrate.
Prepare the Luciferase substrate by dissolving Luciferase Assay Substrate (lyophilized) with Luciferase Assay Buffer.
Remove the supernatant of the cells.
Wash the cells by using 300 μL 1× DPBS solution and add 200 μL Trypsin/EDTA (0.05%) solution to the cells.
Incubate at 37°C for 5 min.
Stop the reaction by adding 300 μL complete medium onto the cells.
Detach the cells by gently pipetting up and down.
Collect the cells in 1.5 mL tubes.
Centrifuge the cells at 200 × g for 4 min at RT and discard supernatant carefully.
Resuspend the cell pellet with 1 mL 1× DPBS and centrifuge at 200 × g for 4 min.
Carefully discard the supernatant and use a 200 μL tip to completely remove the rest of the supernatant without disturbing the cell pellet.
Add 55 μL Luciferase Lysis Buffer (1×) to the cell pellet and mix by pipetting up and down few times.
Incubate the lysates for 15 min at RT.
Transfer 50 μL lysate to 96-well white microtiter plate.
Thaw the Luciferase Substrate for 10–15 min prior to detection at room temperature.
Protect the Luciferase substrate from light.
Start the luminometer and setup the detection software.
Use an integration time of 500 ms.
Mix 90 μL of Luciferase Substrate with 50 μL lysate by carefully swirling the plate.
Incubate the mixed samples for 20 s at room temperature.
Start measurement after the incubation period.
Use a multichannel pipette for simultaneous sample detection of multiple samples.
Alternatively, employ plate readers equipped with injectors for unified time interval between substrate injection and detection.
Incubate samples for 24 hours to ensure consistent luminescence intensity results.
Harvest samples after 24 hours for luciferase activity measurement.
Measure luciferase activity as described in the protocol guidelines.
Keep HuH-7 cells in cell culture for at least 2 passages before starting the experiment.
Wash HuH-7 cells with 1× DPBS.
Incubate the cells with trypsin less than 5 minutes at 37°C to detach them.
Resuspend the detached cells in 10 mL of prewarmed fresh complete DMEM medium.
Seed 2 × 10^5 cells per well in a 12-well plate to reach 70–80% confluency on the next day.
Thaw MLV-control/MLV-SARS-CoV-2-S pseudoviral supernatants and prewarm them at 37°C.
Completely remove medium from the cells.
Replace cell medium with 1-1 ml of pseudoviral supernatant per well.
Incubate the cells at 37°C in 5% CO2.
